Falmouth University GREAT Scholarships 2022 is a combined initiative by Cranfield University and the British Council for master's applicants. The selected scholars will receive £10,000.
GREAT Scholarships are funded by the British Council and the UK government's GREAT Britain Campaign, in partnership with UK higher education institutions.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Be a citizen/passport holder of India or China
Hold an offer for a one-year master's programme at Falmouth
Have applied to study in the 2022-23 academic year (with a September 2022 start)
Eligible candidates can apply for the scholarship by following the steps mentioned below -

Once the applicants have submitted their statement, they will receive confirmation of receipt within 72 hours (if don't receive a confirmation, please get back in touch).
The GREAT scholarships only apply to a September 2022 start on-campus (no January or May intakes or online courses).

Academic departments will attribute awards based on the applicant's previous experience and potential outlined in their personal statement. Where the number of suitable applicants exceeds the number of awards, the academic Heads of the subject will make a final decision using professional judgement.
Aarav Duggal, Senior international Recruitment Officer
